  • They will receive their own card tied to your account and you agree to be solely responsible for all transactions they make with it.
  • All cards will be sent to the address on file for the primary cardholder.
  • Additional owners are not automatically added as authorized users.

disclosure.introText: By completing, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to:

aboutAuthorizedUsersText: We've added your business's additional owners to the cardholder list below. To not issue them a card, delete them from the cardholder list. Need to add a cardholder who is not a beneficial owner of the business? Use the "Add cardholder" button at the bottom of cardholder list.
